40.$description: 40px of padding, gap or margin. Also the least width of the key column in ScriptExplanation's facts (Toolkit D10 440:1428, M08 440:1635); not a width for other boxes.

xs.$description: The smallest buttons: a Button with size xs, such as Copy under a reply (Inbox T5 346:6404, 22 in Figma, on the 4 px grid). Not for inputs or touch targets on phone and tablet.

xl.$description: Sheet rows, full-width phone buttons and the rows of a large menu, such as the Inbox Snooze menu (D12 346:5303).

8.$description: Only the icon of a Badge size xs, the 16 px New pill of the phone's artifact rows (Artifacts M1 406:145, Figma's 9 px star on the 4 px grid, d-100); the Badge sets it on the icon it is given. Not for an icon that stands alone or in a control, which takes icon.12 or more.

sm.$description: A kind tile in a row.

lg.$description: A kind tile in a header.

sm.$description: Width of the framed preview at the start of a desktop artifact row, 64 × 40 (Artifacts D2 403:194). Use it through Thumbnail size sm; not for a card's preview, which fills the card, or for the nav rail, which takes shell.rail.

md.$description: Width of the framed preview at the start of a phone artifact row, 76 × 48 (Artifacts M1 406:122). Use it through Thumbnail size md; not for a desktop row, which takes thumbnail.sm.

lg.$description: Width of the preview of an artifact row in the desktop list view and search results, 128 × 72 at 16:9 (Artifacts D4 403:8217). Use it through Thumbnail size lg; not for a card or the open artifact's preview, which fill their column.

width.$description: Width of the grabber bar at the top of a bottom sheet or drawer.

height.$description: Height of the grabber bar at the top of a bottom sheet or drawer.

rail.$description: Width of the desktop nav rail.

tabBar.$description: Height of the tablet and phone tab bar, with the home-indicator area.

tabGroup.$description: Width of the centred tab group of the tablet tab bar (TabBar size tablet): Toolkit T01 424:3864 to 424:3899 and Inbox T1 346:5575 to 346:5605, x 150 to 606 of the 756 px frame, shared equally by five or six tabs. Not for the phone tab bar, whose tabs share the whole width, or for a pane or a dialog.

listPane.$description: Width of a list pane: Inbox, Artifacts and Toolkit.

sidebar.$description: Width of the Workbench sidebar and the file tree.

sidePane.$description: Width of the Workbench side chat.

widePane.$description: Width of the Workbench subagents pane.

thread.$description: Largest width of a chat column, its messages and its reply box (ChatColumn). 768 is Erik's choice, ChatGPT's 48rem, so the lines stay short enough to read. The 1512 px Figma frames draw the column 1074 wide (Workspaces D06 158:914 and 158:934, D15 to D21); the pages record that as a known difference. On a wider screen the column stops here, centred. Not for a pane or a dialog.

discussionPane.$description: Largest width of the side pane beside an open item (DetailSplit side), such as the Inbox and Artifacts discussion: shell.thread (768) plus the panel's 12 start and 20 end padding (Inbox D14 403:947), so its chat column fills it. A literal value, not derived from shell.thread: change both together. Below it the pane takes what the item leaves, 628 in the 1512 px frames. Not for the AppShell side slot, which takes sidePane or widePane.

detailWide.$description: Largest content width of a detail column (Container size detail) when its space is at least detailWideFrom wide; the column then sits in the middle. Below that it is shell.detail (748), as every Figma frame draws it.

detailWideFrom.$description: The width of the space (the AppShell detail) from which a detail column takes shell.detailWide and centres itself, and a Toolkit item or full page (Container size item or page) stops at shell.itemWide or shell.pageWide and centres itself. Wider than the 1448 px detail of the 1512 px Figma frames, so no frame changes. Only for that container query; not a width of a box.

itemWide.$description: Largest width of an open Toolkit item (Container size item), padding included: 948 of content and the desktop's 40 sides, as the 1512 px Figma frames draw it (D03 427:250, D17 474:393, D19 482:349). It applies only when the space (the AppShell detail) is at least detailWideFrom wide; the item then sits in the middle. Below that the item fills its space. Not for the Inbox task column, which takes detail and detailWide, or for a pane or a dialog.

pageWide.$description: Largest width of a Toolkit full page (Container size page), padding included: 1384 of content and 32 sides, the whole detail of the 1512 px Figma frames (map D02 426:53, Activity D11 444:153, workflow D13 446:153). It applies only when the space (the AppShell detail) is at least detailWideFrom wide; the page then sits in the middle. Below that the page fills its space. Not for an open item, which takes itemWide, or for a pane or a dialog.

popoverXs.$description: Width of the Workbench skill picker, the short list of skills a composer opens after "/" (Workbench D1 105:406). Not for a menu or a filter, which is at least popoverSm (240).

submenu.$description: Width of a menu's submenu, the list that opens beside a row such as Move to workspace (Workbench D1 105:473). Not for a menu a button opens, which is at least popoverSm (240).

popoverPhone.$description: Width of the phone's New menu, the short menu that + at the top of the Workspaces list opens (M15 208:515), so it leaves the end of the row title under it clear. Use it through Menu width phone. Not for a desktop or tablet menu, which is at least popoverSm (240), or a submenu, which takes submenu (200).

popoverSort.$description: Width of a menu whose choices have a description line, such as the Inbox Sort menu (D9 346:4000). Not for a popover of controls, which takes popover (320).

popoverFilter.$description: Width of the Inbox Filter menu (D4 346:1737). Other filter and snooze popovers take popover (320).

popover.$description: Width of a filter or snooze popover.

popoverPicker.$description: Width of the Run in picker (Inbox D3 346:1234). Not for the Workbench side chat, which takes sidePane.

pickerMin.$description: Least width of a composer's picker list, such as the skill list after "/": Popover width composer is 40% of the composer's width, at least this and at most pickerMax (screen review R8). Not for a popover of a fixed width, such as a menu (popoverSm) or the Run in picker (popoverPicker), or for the phone, whose list takes the composer's whole width (Popover width trigger).

pickerMax.$description: Most width of a composer's picker list, such as the skill list after "/": Popover width composer is 40% of the composer's width, at least pickerMin and at most this, so it stays a list and not a pane on a wide screen (screen review R8). Not for a popover of a fixed width, such as the Run in picker (popoverPicker), or for the phone, whose list takes the composer's whole width (Popover width trigger).

dialogLg.$description: Width of the New chat dialog.

dialogWide.$description: Width of a dialog that shows a long text to read, such as the Inbox suggested prompt (D8 346:3543). Not for a confirm dialog or a form.

detail.$description: Most content width of a detail column, such as the Inbox task (D1 346:306). Use it through Container size detail; not for a pane or a dialog.

safeAreaBottom.$description: Bottom padding for the phone home indicator.

keyboard.$description: The phone's on-screen keyboard with Safari's form bar (Workbench M10 147:97): the inset AppShell expects before a first keyboard is measured. Not a layout size; never size a page or a pane with it.
